    MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_biproduct

    Projective dimension of a finite biproduct #

    A finite biproduct has projective dimension below a fixed bound when every summand does. This small generic lemma is shared by the weak-positivity and Iyama-realization arguments.

    A finite biproduct has projective dimension below d if every summand does.
